items.label: Central Bank Balance Sheet, % GDP
items.source: National Bank of Romania Monthly Bulletin / Romania Ministry of Finance GDP snapshot
items.note: Central-bank total assets scaled by nominal GDP from BIS/World Bank where available, or official national-bank and GDP snapshots where automated coverage is missing; monthly numerator is paired with annual GDP, so use as a balance-sheet scale proxy rather than exact national-account ratio. Maintained in config/manual_indicators.yaml; revise manually when source values change. Source validation: Latest observation is 636 days old for monthly data. Short history returned by adapter. Manual snapshot maintained because BIS CBTA does not currently return Romania coverage in this pipeline and BNR's direct statistical-data endpoints reject automated access in this environment. Update when the latest BNR monthly bulletin and current-price GDP snapshot are refreshed.
